Good food depending on the locations but badly manage.
Apr 2019 • Family
I ate at two of their locations: the first one was in district 1 and the second one in district 7. The first one the food was good but the service was terrible. We were kind of force to order one type of combo as they ran out of the other combos. We chose the juicy sauce and it was delicious. This is the only positive part of the dining experience. The wait staff seem like they were in constant state of daze. We asked for extra bread and that took about 20 min. They kept telling us it was being warm but it's only bread. How long can it really take. The second time we went which was in district 7 nothing was good about that experience. It was only us and one other family there but the food took forever to serve. We ordered the same sauce, juicy, but it didn't taste the same. It lacked flavor and did not taste anything like the one in district 1. It was as if the two restaurants were from two different chains. The biggest gripe I have about this place is it charged us 10% for VAT tax but they would not give us the red government receipt. They told us they would mail it to us. I finally got an email for one receipt but it had the wrong information on it. I wrote them back asking them to send the correct receipt but they did not respond. This was almost a month ago. Currently, I didn't receive an email for the second receipt also. Often restaurants do this so they can cheat the customers and the government. I would not recommend this place for business dinners or family dinners for that matter.

Good concept, very poorly executed.
Apr 2019 • Family
It looked very promising until we tried to workout the menu. Although the menu was in English the staff could not help in making it clear. The combo we requested didn’t have the crab and the pricing of it minus it was very dubious. Nevertheless we ordered it with the lemon garlic butter. 
It was tasty, mean but tasty. However, to charge for the baguette - essential to mop up the sauce - It’s looked very promising until we tried to workout the menu. Although the menu was in English the staff could not help in making it clear. The combo we requested didn’t have the crab and the pricing of it minus it was very dubious. 
Nevertheless we ordered it with the lemon garlic butter. It was very tasty, mean but tasty. To charge for a baguette - essential for mopping up the sauce - and at that markup, considering the price of the dish, is heinous. The pathetic inclusion of the other elements of the combo, a miserly slice of sausage, a solitary wedge of sweet potato and a few centimetres of corn is contemptible.
The staff seemed more intent on chatting to each other rather than serving and one of us had to leave the table to approach them and get there attention to serve more beer despite waving madly beforehand. 
An attempt at a Nando’s style of operation. With a few tweaks, properly trained staff and a proper review of prices or portions and it could have real potential.
